nav.moreDescription: Contracts, invoices, acts, deliveries, company and profile

common.notFoundText: There is no such page, or it belongs to another company.
common.viewOnly: View only: actions are available to a contact with approval rights
common.reasonRequired: Give a reason — without it the provider will not know what to fix.
common.crashText: The page failed to open because of an error. Reload it; if that does not help, contact your manager.

documents.preparingLive: The document “{{name}}” is being prepared — it will download as soon as it is ready
documents.stillPreparing: The document is still being prepared. Try downloading it in a minute.

login.title: Sign in to the cabinet
login.subtitle: The cabinet opens by invitation. Enter the e-mail the invitation was sent to and we will send a sign-in link.
login.newClientHint: Haven't worked with us yet? Leave a request and a manager will get in touch.

sent.title: E-mail sent
sent.text: If {{email}} is in the cabinet, a sign-in link has been sent to it. It is valid for 15 minutes and opens once.
sent.textNoEmail: If the address is in the cabinet, a sign-in link has been sent to it. It is valid for 15 minutes and opens once.
sent.mockLink: Open the link from the email (mock)

magic.expiredText: The link has expired or was already opened. Request a new one.

telegram.failedText: If you are not our client yet, message the bot and a manager will invite you to the cabinet.

errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests, try again in an hour.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Access is closed, please contact your manager.

newClient.title: I am a new client
newClient.intro: Tell us what you need and a manager will get in touch and invite you to the cabinet.
newClient.orTelegram: Prefer chatting? Message us in Telegram.
newClient.unavailableText: Message us in Telegram and a manager will reply and invite you to the cabinet.
newClient.sentTitle: Thank you! Your request has been sent
newClient.sentText: A manager will contact you by phone or e-mail during business hours. If you prefer chatting, message us in Telegram.

form.name: Your name
form.contactsHint: Phone or e-mail — one is enough.
form.textPlaceholder: For example: POS integration with 1C for 5 stores, by the end of the month
form.website: Do not fill in this field
form.consent: I agree to the processing of my personal data so that you can contact me about this request

errors.name_required: Tell us how to address you.
errors.contact_required: Enter a phone number or an e-mail — at least one.
errors.invalid_phone: The number is not recognized — enter it with the country code, e.g. +998 90 123 45 67.
errors.invalid_email: The e-mail address is not valid.
errors.consent_required: We cannot answer your request without consent to the processing of personal data.
errors.form_too_fast: The form was sent too quickly — check the fields and send it again.
errors.form_token_expired: The form has expired — reload the page and send your request again.
errors.form_token_invalid: The form has expired — reload the page and send your request again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests from your address — try again in an hour or message us in Telegram.
errors.network: No connection to the server — check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Could not send the request — try again later or message us in Telegram.
errors.tokenUnavailable: The form is unavailable right now. Try again or message us in Telegram.

profile.title: Profile
profile.canAct: Can approve: accept quotes, sign contracts, accept acts
profile.name: Name

requests.title: Requests
requests.emptyText: Your requests and their status will appear here: new, in progress, quoted, closed.

requestNew.title: New request
requestNew.summaryHint: Describe the task in your own words: what, how much and by when. Up to 5000 characters.
requestNew.summaryRequired: Describe what you need — at least one sentence.
requestNew.linesHint: List items or work in free text — exact part numbers are not required. Empty lines are not sent.
requestNew.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be a positive number, e.g. 12 or 2.5.
requestNew.attachmentsLater: For now send specifications and drawings to your manager — file upload to the cabinet is coming later.
requestNew.attachmentsHint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX or images up to 10 MB
requestNew.viewOnlyTitle: Requests can be created by a contact with approval rights
requestNew.viewOnlyText: Ask a colleague with this right or your manager to send the request.

next.new: Request received — a manager will pick it up.
next.quoted: The quote is ready — open it below.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.emptyText: As soon as the manager sends a quote it will appear here — accept or reject it right from the cabinet.

quoteDetail.title: Quote {{number}}
quoteDetail.acceptText: Total {{total}}. Enter the confirmation code from the message. The contract is created automatically after acceptance.
quoteDetail.codeHint: The code is 6 digits from the message. If it did not arrive, send it again.
quoteDetail.codeTooShort: The code is at least {{min}} characters long.
quoteDetail.acceptedPending: The contract is being drawn up — it will appear under “Contracts”, where you can sign it.
quoteDetail.acceptedReadyToSign: Contract {{number}} is ready — sign it under “Contracts”.
quoteDetail.rejectText: Tell us what did not fit — the manager will take it into account in the next version.
quoteDetail.rejectPlaceholder: For example: the delivery time does not work for us
quoteDetail.expiredText: It can no longer be accepted. Ask your manager to update the offer.
quoteDetail.requestCodeText: Total {{total}}. Press “Get code” — we will send a confirmation code to your Telegram or e-mail. The contract is created automatically after acceptance.

codeSent.telegram: The code was sent to Telegram. Valid for {{minutes}} min.
codeSent.telegramTo: The code was sent to Telegram ({{to}}). Valid for {{minutes}} min.
codeSent.email: The code was sent to {{to}}. Valid for {{minutes}} min.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.emptyText: A contract is created automatically once a quote is accepted; you can sign it here.
contracts.signText: By signing you confirm, on behalf of your company, that you agree to the contract terms. The signature is recorded with your name and time.
contracts.signedClient: Contract {{number}} signed. Waiting for the provider to sign.
contracts.signedBoth: Contract {{number}} is signed by both parties.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyText: Issued invoices, payments and due dates will appear here.

acts.title: Acts
acts.emptyText: Acts for completed deliveries and services: accept or return with a reason.
acts.acceptText: You confirm that the delivery or work under this act is complete and you have no claims.
acts.returnText: The act goes back to the provider for correction. Describe what is wrong.
acts.returnPlaceholder: For example: the serial number is missing
acts.scanHint: PDF or image up to 10 MB. You can also accept the act without a scan.

scanProblem.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB — choose a smaller one.
scanProblem.badType: A PDF or an image is required.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.emptyText: Status per line, expected date and tracking number.
deliveries.disputeText: Describe the issue (defect, missing parts, damage). The manager will contact you.
deliveries.disputePlaceholder: For example: labeling defect or transport damage

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyText: Quotes, contracts, invoices, acts and waybills — download them from here.
documents.emptyKindText: Choose another kind or show all documents.
documents.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, title, or deal…

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.emptyText: Published goods and services with price and availability.
catalog.notFoundText: Change the search or describe what you need in a new request — the manager will find it.

catalogItem.priceOnRequestHint: Send a request — the manager will reply with a quote with price and lead time.

team.title: Team
team.emptyTitle: No one in the team yet
team.emptyText: Invite colleagues so they can see the company’s requests, quotes and documents.
team.rightsHint: Your manager can change a colleague’s rights or the primary contact.
team.inviteText: Your colleague will get an invitation to the cabinet through the selected channels.

fields.name: Full name
fields.canActHint: Accept quotes, sign contracts, accept acts, create requests. Without it — view only.

problems.name: Enter a name.
problems.phone: Enter the phone number in international format.

apiErrors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the right to do this.

apiErrors.INVALID_INIT_DATA: Telegram did not confirm the sign-in. Open the cabinet from the bot again.
apiErrors.CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: Contact not found. Ask your manager to invite you to the cabinet.
apiErrors.MAGIC_LINK_EXPIRED: The sign-in link has expired or was already used.

apiErrors.CONTRACT_FINALIZED: The contract was already signed or cancelled — refresh the page.
apiErrors.QUOTE_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or was not requested. Check the code in the message or request a new one.
apiErrors.QUOTE_EXPIRED: The quote has expired and can no longer be accepted. Ask your manager to update the offer.
apiErrors.INN_INVALID: The tax ID has 9 to 14 digits.
apiErrors.TEAM_MEMBER_EXISTS: A colleague with this e-mail is already in the team.
apiErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a little and try again.
apiErrors.CONTACT_CHANNEL_REQUIRED: We have nowhere to send the code: no e-mail is set and Telegram is not connected. Ask your manager to add a contact channel.
apiErrors.CONTACT_EMAIL_REQUIRED: A contact e-mail is required for this.
apiErrors.INVALID_CHANNEL: This contact channel is not available.
apiErrors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 10 MB.
apiErrors.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The uploaded file was not found — upload it again.
apiErrors.DELIVERY_LINE_NOT_ACCEPTABLE: This item can no longer be accepted or disputed: it is not delivered yet or a decision was already made. Reload the page.
apiErrors.DOCUMENT_PENDING: The document is still being prepared. Try again in a minute.
apiErrors.CONFLICT: The data has changed — reload the page and try again.

apiErrors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The server rejected the request. Reload the page and try again.

actionRequired.allClear: All documents processed — no action required right now.
